title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 1: Yuu Kinoshita
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．１ ～木下優～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 1: Kinoshita Yuu is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Yuu Kinoshita. It includes a gallery of photos and video clips of the idol, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame. Winning three rounds of the minigame will unlock a bonus video.
